notes:
# v1.4.19 - Cloudflare-blocked sources work without passing a browser check

- Fixed: sources that sit behind a Cloudflare browser check (royalroad,
  novelfull, mgeko, freewebnovel, toonily, manhuatop) used to fail even when
  the network was fine, because the app's requests were recognisable as
  non-browser traffic and rejected before any page was served. The app now
  presents a browser-shaped TLS handshake on those sources - pinned cipher
  suites, ALPN and a Host-first header order - so the request is
  indistinguishable from a real browser's at connection time and the check is
  passed automatically instead of appearing as a blocked source.
- Fixed: the provider User-Agent was incoherent - parts of it described a
  different browser than the rest - which made the mismatch easy for
  anti-bot systems to flag. All providers now send one consistent,
  browser-accurate User-Agent.
- Fixed: top-level navigation requests on those sources now carry the
  Sec-Fetch navigation headers a real browser sends, closing another
  difference that made automated requests stand out.
- Note: no action needed - just update. Sources that previously showed as
  blocked should start working on their own; if one still shows as blocked,
  open it once from the button the app offers and it will stay unlocked.
